Laggam is feel good movie with top notch production values. A clean entertainer in today version of our lives. Movie is well directed drama with the characters shown close to real life. All the artists were well chosen to make the 25 crafts of this movie entertained through out. Rajendra Prasad and Rohini's acting is superb through out. Music by Charan Arjun is absolutely fine and visuals of the songs adds real value to the movie. Producer Venu has given a well crafted and deserved movie to all sorts of audiences and I am sure it will be a great HIT. Congratulations to the entire team.

Bhanu Kotta.

Nice attempt by the director to mix entertainment with much needed social message for both parents and young generations. Filled movie with human emotions that are missing broadly in the society today.

First Telugu movie to shine light on Telangana region marriage process in details.

New hero and heroine acted very well and look very refreshing. Very good background music, songs and emotions this movie Laggam definitely deserves more appreciation from the audience.

Audience need to encourage such an attempt to make nice movies by the new upcoming producers and directors to see more of such movies in future.

Laggam: The Craziest Wedding Ever marks a refreshing return to family-centric Telugu cinema, offering a heartfelt story with a strong message. Directed by Ramesh Cheppala, the film follows Sadanandam (Rajendra Prasad) as he arranges his daughter Manasa's (Pragya Nagra) marriage to her cousin Chaitanya (Sai Ronak), a well-settled software engineer. However, when Chaitanya loses his job, the engagement is jeopardized, reflecting the weight society places on career stability. Rajendra Prasad brings warmth and humor, showcasing the middle-class family's values and sacrifices. Mani Sharma's music and Balreddy's cinematography enhance this relatable, thought-provoking family entertainer.

One of the decent and clean movie. Songs were tremendous. Absolute family sentimental movie. 100% worth watching. Clean hit of 2024. Rajendra Prasad and Rohini's performance is wonderful. Second half of the movie is really great. Inthenemo song is too good and every married women must watch movie. Father's love towards daughters career and sisters love towards brothers family is shown in different way. Music of charan and background score of manisharma is attractive. Movie's production values, dialogues, story and direction is beautiful. Overall Laggam movie is 100% full meals for all Family's.

Laggam starts off slow but picks up momentum once the story starts to gather pace, with very good production values and a decent narration laggam is definitely worth a watch. The lead actor is definitely one to watch out for the future, has amazing screen presence and good acting skills to go with energetic dancing skills. Set in rural backdrop of telangana village laggam showcases modernity of the villages nowadays. Although the telangana accent used for some of the actors was not to the mark it's only a small if in the movie. The interval scene and the second half make the film worth a watch and definitely recommend it.
